notes.title: Invitation Event is Now Live | Signed Photos, Little Cards, and More Await You!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Players:[/h3]
Thank you for your support for Lights and Shadow! To celebrate one week since the game’s launch, we have prepared a special invitation event. We warmly welcome enthusiastic players to invite their friends to join this journey.

[h2]1. Event Details[/h2]
Players who purchase c on Steam and successfully invite 2 friends to purchase the game will be eligible to participate in the event.

[h2]2. How to Participate[/h2]
Please provide the following information:

Purchase screenshots for a total of [b]3 people[/b] (yourself and the invited friends)
Corresponding Steam ID screenshots and order numbers
All accounts shown in the screenshots must have a gameplay time of over 2 hours
[b]Registration Link: https://zv05ra52jt0.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcnvLxmQjubYTGE6elXVd3grd[/b]

[h2]3. Event Duration[/h2]
From now until all prizes have been distributed.

[h2]4. Event Rewards[/h2]
The [b]first 200[/b] players who invite [b]2 friends[/b] will receive:

1 random signed photo
3 Little Card merchandise items

[h2]5. Special Rewards[/h2]
The [b]first 10[/b] players who invite [b]10 friends[/b] will receive:

1 set of 5 signed photos
3 special edition Little Card merchandise items
Purchase screenshots for a total of [b]11 people[/b] (yourself and the invited friends) are required

[h2]6. Special Notes[/h2]
Each game purchase can only be used to participate in the invitation event once. Games that have already participated in the event (including those purchased by invited players) cannot be used again as either the inviter or the invitee.
Game orders used for a set of signed photos will not qualify for participation in the individual signed photo event.
The event is only open to users who purchase the genuine The Life of Light and Shadow on the Steam platform; non-genuine orders, CDK exchanges, or refunded orders are considered invalid.
Impersonating another user or fabricating screenshots is strictly prohibited; any violation will result in disqualification.
Please do not post any prohibited or false content, or you will be disqualified from the evaluation.
We recommend joining the official QQ group. If the winners cannot be contacted and therefore do not receive their prizes, it will be considered an automatic forfeit.
Prizes will be shipped within 10 to 15 working days after the winners are announced and are only available for delivery within mainland China.
The final interpretation of the event is owned by Nanjing Qiehe Interactive Technology Co., Ltd.

[h3]May you find your own resonance amid light and shadow.[/h3]

notes.title: Event Live | Share your brilliant derivative creations and win exclusive prizes!
notes.content:
[h3]Dear Players,[/h3]
To celebrate the official launch of Lights and Shadow, we are inviting all players to participate in a creative content campaign. If you love expressing yourself and enjoy creating, you're welcome to join in and help illuminate this journey of choices and destiny in your own way.

[h2]1. Submission Guidelines[/h2]
Please publish your creative work on platforms like [b]Douyin[/b] or [b]BiliBili[/b], and make sure to include tags such as [b]#光影人生# #光影人生互动影游#[/b] in your post. There are no restrictions on format—videos, illustrations, edited clips, and written posts are all accepted.

[h2]2. How to Participate[/h2]
Provide your Steam ID and the link to your submitted content.
Multiple submissions are allowed, and each work will be judged independently.
[b]Submission link: https://zv05ra52jt0.feishu.cn/share/base/form/shrcn6OdBsPRuhaK2pZH01ms21f[/b]

[h2]3. Event Duration[/h2]
From now until April 21, 2025 at 23:59 (GMT+8)

[h2]4. Evaluation and Prizes[/h2]
After the event ends, the organizing team will evaluate all submissions based on overall quality, creativity, and audience engagement. The following prizes will be awarded:

[b]First Prize (1 winner)[/b]: One mystery puzzle + a full set of 5 signed photos + 3 special character cards
[b]Second Prize (10 winners)[/b]: 2 randomly selected signed photos + 3 character cards

[h2]5. Special Notes[/h2]

Only users who have purchased the official version of Lights and Shadow on Steam are eligible. Pirated copies, CD key redemptions, and refunded orders will be considered invalid.

Using someone else’s account or falsifying purchase records is strictly prohibited and will result in disqualification.

Please refrain from posting inappropriate or misleading content. Violations will result in disqualification.

We recommend joining the official QQ group: 687983303. If you cannot be contacted after winning, your eligibility for the prize will be forfeited.

Do not delete your content before or during the prize announcement, as submissions will be reviewed twice—once during the event and again before rewards are issued.

Prizes will be shipped within 10 to 15 working days after the winners are announced. Delivery is limited to mainland China.

Nanjing Qiehe Interactive Technology Co., Ltd. reserves the final right of interpretation for this event.

[h3]We invite every player to reignite the path of destiny with your creativity and passion.[/h3]
